meta.name: lcx-report-bug
meta.description: Create a high-signal bug issue or PR in the repo that owns the defect. Use this whenever the user asks to report, file, open, or triage a LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI bug, especially when they need source-backed root cause, reproduction steps, fix guidance, and GitHub routing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动创建带根因分析和复现步骤的缺陷报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在GitHub仓库中提交高质量Bug Issue或修复PR。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically create bug reports with root cause analysis and reproduction steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to file high-signal bug issues or fix PRs in GitHub repos.

howto.what: 当你说要报 bug 时,Claude 会先调查并核对源码,定位缺陷所属仓库,再生成一份英文 GitHub issue 或 PR,包含复现步骤、根因、修复建议和验证计划,并打上 lazycodex-generated 标签。
howto.when: 当你要上报、打开或处理 LazyCodex、omo-codex、Codex 插件等仓库的 bug,并需要根因分析和复现步骤时触发。

say.text: 帮我给 LazyCodex 的插件报一个 bug,查清根因并开 issue
say.note: Claude 会定位仓库并生成带证据的 issue。

say.text: 搜索一下这个错误是否已有 open issue,有就补充证据

howto.what_en: When you report a bug, Claude investigates and cross-checks source code, routes to the correct repo, then produces an English GitHub issue or PR with reproduction steps, root cause, fix guidance, verification plan, and the lazycodex-generated label.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to report, open, or triage bugs for LazyCodex, omo-codex, Codex plugins, etc., needing root-cause analysis and repro steps.

say_en.text: File a bug for the LazyCodex plugin, find the root cause, and open an issue
say_en.note: Claude locates the repo and creates an evidence-backed issue.

say_en.text: This Codex CLI crash is reproducible, submit a fix PR to openai/codex
say_en.note: A PR is created only when the target repo allows it.

say_en.text: Search if this error already has an open issue and add evidence if so
